director.text: Namaste Riya, main Asha, tumhari AI teacher. Aaj cricket pitch jaise number line par fractions dekhenge. Tumhe cricket mein kya pasand hai?
haan, samajh aaya

Cricket pitch ko ek number line socho: ek stump 0 par hai aur doosra stump 1 par. Batsman run ke liye bhaaga aur theek beech mein ruk gaya. Woh pitch ke ek pakke spot par khada hai, aur us spot ka bhi ek number hota hai. Achha, Riya.
haan samajh gayi
Screen par 0 se 1 ki line hai, aur theek beech mein ek mark. Yeh mark 0 se 1 ko 2 barabar gaps mein baant raha hai, aur is mark ka naam 1/2 hai. Ab tak samajh aaya?
kal maine cricket khela, sixer maara

Wah, kal cricket mein tumne sixer maara—ball seedha boundary ke paar! Is baat par is question ke turant baad wapas aayenge. Zoya ka kehna hai ki 1/3, 3 ke paas aata hai. 1/3 kahaan hai: isi 0 se 1 wali line par, ya 3 ke paas?

Diya hai: ghar 0 par, school 1 km par, beech mein 3 khambe, barabar doori par. Dhoondhna hai: pehle khambe ki ghar se doori, km mein. Chalo, aage dekhte hain.
theek hai
Pehla kadam dekho. Rekha banao aur ghar ko 0 par, school ko 1 par likho: 0 se 1 tak ki rekha, kyunki 0 se 1 tak ka poora raasta hi humara ek poora hai. Yeh kadam saaf hai?

Ab doosra kadam. Khambe nahi, beech ke gaps gino: 3 khambe, toh 4 barabar hisse, kyunki beech ke nishaan se gaps hamesha ek zyada hote hain. Ab agla kadam dekhte hain.
